req.title: Update only by author
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 403 Forbidden when a user attempts to update a post they did not author.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that only the author of a post should be able to update it. This is a critical authorization check to ensure data integrity and user privacy. The test suite includes a positive case where the author updates their post, a negative case where a non-author attempts to update a post, and a boundary case to ensure the system behaves correctly at the edge of authorization logic.

tests.name: Author can update their own post
preconditions: User 'test' is the author of post with id 1
actions: Attempt to update post with id 1
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()

# Log in as 'test'
client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'test', 'password': 'test'})

# Attempt to update the post
r = client.post('/1/update', data={'title': 'updated title', 'body': 'updated body'})

assert r.status_code == 302
assert r.headers['Location'] == '/'

tests.name: Non-author cannot update post
preconditions: User 'other' is not the author of post with id 1
actions: Attempt to update post with id 1
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()

# Log in as 'other'
client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'other', 'password': 'other'})

# Attempt to update the post
r = client.post('/1/update', data={'title': 'unauthorized update', 'body': 'unauthorized body'})

assert r.status_code == 403

tests.name: Boundary case: Author updates post with minimal changes
preconditions: User 'test' is the author of post with id 1
actions: Attempt to update post with id 1 with minimal changes
